content: Hi how can i assist you today
Billboards switch messages to the exact word I’m thinking. It keeps happening on my commute.
Digital billboards rotate on fixed schedules and ad playlists. Which exits and approximate times did you notice the match?
Exit 12 around 8:20 a.m., and again near the stadium at 5:45 p.m.
Those slots may be tied to commuter windows. Do the same words appear if you pass those boards a bit earlier or later than usual?
I haven’t tried changing the time.
A small variance—five or ten minutes—can show whether the same creative returns at a consistent clock time rather than following your thought.
If I see the same ad regardless, that points to the schedule.
Right. A quick photo with timestamp on two different days would make the rotation pattern easier to compare.
